name: Doximity Ask (DoxGPT)
description: Doximity Ask (formerly DoxGPT, rebranded May 2026) is a free clinical AI assistant for verified US healthcare professionals as part of the Doximity Clinical AI Suite. Answers clinical questions with PeerCheck™ verification by 12,000+ physician experts co-chaired by Eric Topol and former Surgeon General Regina Benjamin. Includes 3,200+ drug monographs with dosing/interaction data, free full PDF access to top medical journals, and generates SOAP notes, discharge summaries, patient education, and differential diagnoses with guideline citations (AHA, ACC, NCCN, IDSA). ICD-10 and CPT coding assistance built in. 300,000+ unique clinicians used Doximity AI in Q3, deployed at 165+ health systems including 8 of top 20 US hospitals. Free for all verified US physicians, NPs, PAs, and medical students. Enterprise licensing available separately.

faqs.a: Yes. Doximity Ask is completely free for verified US physicians, NPs, PAs, and medical students. Part of the Doximity Clinical AI Suite. Enterprise licensing available separately for health systems.

faqs.q: What is PeerCheck on Doximity Ask?
faqs.a: PeerCheck™ is Doximity's physician verification system. Over 12,000 physician experts (co-chaired by Eric Topol and former Surgeon General Regina Benjamin) continuously evaluate and improve AI-generated answers. PeerCheck-certified answers link to reviewing physician profiles.

faqs.q: What can I do with Doximity Ask?
faqs.a: Ask clinical questions (drug interactions, dosing, differential diagnoses, guidelines), access 3,200+ drug monographs, get free full PDF journal access, generate SOAP notes and discharge summaries, and receive ICD-10/CPT coding suggestions.

faqs.q: How many clinicians use Doximity AI?
faqs.a: Over 300,000 unique clinicians used Doximity's AI tools in Q3. The Clinical AI Suite is deployed at 165+ health systems including 8 of the top 20 US hospitals. Enterprise contracts include Scripps, UCHealth, UC San Diego, and others.

faqs.q: Doximity Ask vs Glass AI: which is better?
faqs.a: Doximity Ask is free (ad-supported) with PeerCheck physician verification and journal access. Glass AI ($20-200/mo) offers differential diagnosis generation and EHR integration on higher tiers. For free clinical AI with drug reference, Doximity. For paid clinical decision support with EHR integration, Glass AI.
